I'm not certain if my body adjusted to the roughness, or if the towel softened after a few uses. reviews.t: Perfect... and I'm an expert on these!
reviews.x: Have used this type of Japanese towel forever for scrubbing my back. I've tried many brands, and they're usually too soft and wimpy and/or too short in length.  This one is PERFECT in abrasiveness and length! After trying out this one, I ordered a second.  I know these last a long time, but years from now when the first one tears, I don't want to go through the arduous process of finding the perfect one again!

I've been buying these Japanese scrubby washcloths for years. They really help keep my dry skin smooth and soft without irritation and I've had far fewer breakouts since using these cloths. I recently found out my family has been using  my washcloths 🤢 instead of their poufs, so now I'm buying everyone their own scrubby washcloths! Lol

reviews.t: Feels like stepping out of a spa after each use.

Scrubber length is long enough for hard to reach back areas, awesome lathering with bar soap or bodywash gel, rinse well and hangs to dry, quick drying, and easy to travel with.

claims.text: Reviewers find the cloth genuinely hard and effective for serious scrubbing and exfoliation.
Many users report noticeably softer, smoother skin after use, including relief for keratosis pilaris.
Some reviewers warn the cloth is very rough and may be too harsh, especially for those new to scrubbing or with sensitive skin.
Users praise the Salux brand and its large size that does not shrink, comparing it favorably to other brands.
A few reviewers mention sizing issues, such as wishing it were smaller or having to cut it.
